channel.title: Sagar Chand Agarwal — Writing
channel.description: Essays on fintech architecture, LLM agents in production, cloud infrastructure and engineering leadership.

item.title: Building a Modern Talent Intelligence Platform
item.description: What the architecture of a production-grade talent platform actually looks like, layer by layer — from user-facing channels to containerized cloud infrastructure.

item.title: Building Financial ETL Pipelines That Don't Break at 3AM
item.description: Two years of lessons from ingesting 10GB+ of financial data daily — NAVs, prices, yields, corporate actions — including the failures we would rather forget.

item.title: LLM Agents in Fintech: What Actually Works in Production
item.description: Shipping an agentic portfolio assistant without hallucinated numbers, DPDP violations or accidental investment advice. Guardrails, latency and what survived contact with clients.

item.title: Scaling an Eng Team from 2 to 15: The Mistakes I Made
item.description: What nobody tells you about going from two engineers to fifteen: hiring for judgment over skills, ownership, and the things I would do differently.

item.title: Multi-cloud Without the Chaos: Our AWS + GCP + Azure Setup
item.description: Most advice says pick one cloud and go deep. We run three. Why that was the right call for us, and the patterns that keep it manageable.

item.title: ISO 27001 for Startups: A CTO's Survival Guide
item.description: How a 15-person fintech got certified without a six-figure consultant engagement — what the 114 controls actually demand, and what to automate.

item.title: Real-time Portfolio NAV: The Database Design That Scaled
item.description: Portfolio valuation looks like units × NAV. In practice it is corporate actions, FX, accrued income and XIRR for thousands of clients, updated continuously.
